about_the_game:
The official soundtrack for IN HEAT: Lustful Nights, including the background tracks from the game, and even some that are no longer available.

Listen to all of your favorite IN HEAT tracks without the added pressure of bombs going off, girls at your window, or first date jitters.

The Soundtrack is updated as new tracks are added to the main game.
Both MP3 and FLAC files are included.
